metadata.case_name: NG KOON KI PETER v. HILTI (HONG KONG) LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Anchor testing technician (Hilti); previously collected accounts
plaintiff.occupation_after: Unable to undertake work on construction sites; able to undertake indoor office work such as assistant messenger or office assistant

injuries.description: Prolapse of intervertebral disc at L4/5 (disc prolapse) with nerve root impression
source: sprained back causing a prolapse of his intervertebral disc at L4/5.
acute prolapsed disc with nerve root impression.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: When he sits or walks for more than 20 minutes, or sits up from a lying position, he feels pain over his back.
Feelings of stiffness and numbness radiate from his back down his buttock to his left leg.
He has weakness in his back and left lower limb.
The pain radiates down from his left buttock to his heel and associates with numbness over the back of the calf and the sole of his foot.
Will be unable to perform heavy manual work; back pain will be triggered by frequent bending which will prevent him from climbing activities.

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency treatment at United Christian Hospital

losses.description: will be unable to perform heavy manual work; his back pain will be triggered by frequent bending which will prevent him from climbing activities.
pain and suffering and loss of enjoyment of life
